study_type_evidence.quote: Binding assays were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument. HSA ... or albumin from mouse serum ... were immobilized by amine coupling to research grade CM5 chip

in_vitro_detail: Surface plasmon resonance (Biacore T200) steady-state affinity measurement of ELP-GFP constructs against immobilised mouse serum albumin and human serum albumin; quantitative LC-QTOF-MS of thermolysin-digested ELPs and intact-mass MALDI-TOF; dynamic light scattering solubility/self-assembly analysis; Proteostat thioredoxin-1 activity assay on trx, trx-ELP(10pAzF) and trx-ELP(10FA) with and without fivefold excess HSA; GFP fluorescence quantification; expression in the genomically recoded E. coli strain C321.deltaA.

notes: The body reports only two explicit half-life numbers: 1.7 h for ELP(0FA)-GFP and a 28-33 h range shared by ISAz-treated ELP(5FA)-GFP, ISAz-treated ELP(10FA)-GFP and untreated ELP(10FA)-GFP. The seven construct-specific values in the PeplLife2 metadata (33.3, 31.7, 27.9, 1.6, 1.9, 19.6, 18.5 h) are NOT printed in the body; they are in SI Appendix, Table S1, which is not part of this file. Similarly, the full one-letter construct sequences listed in the metadata do not appear in the body - only the 15-residue ELP repeat VPGAGVPGXGVPGGG (X = Tyr or pAzF) is given, and note that this repeat is written in a different register than the metadata sequences. Dose is stated in two equivalent ways ('50 ug of each protein variant (10 uM in PBS)' in Results; '120 uL of 10 uM ELP-GFP' in Methods). Blood sampling schedule: 1, 4, 8, 16 and 24 h then daily for 7 d. Both intravenous and subcutaneous routes were used; the body states subcutaneous dosing gave a delayed peak concentration but equivalent half-lives, with supporting data only in the SI. Tmax and Cmax values are never reported numerically. Albumin half-lives quoted in the body for reference (MSA 35 h in mice; HSA ~19 d in humans) are literature/model values, not measurements made here. Organs (brain, lungs, heart, spleen, liver, kidneys) and serum were collected from dosed mice for Alexa Fluor 647 imaging and cytokine quantification; this is terminal sampling from an in vivo study rather than an ex vivo treatment assay, so no ex vivo study type was assigned.
